<b>Dreg Catchers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Moorbugs]] charged to catch dregs of [[Silk]] that fall from [[the Citadel]].<ref>Dreg Catcher [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Bug charged to catch dregs of Silk that fall from the Citadel."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Dreg Catchers are either patrolling an area and pausing on occasion, or standing in place holding their dreg catcher in the air. After becoming aggressive, they perform either of the moves below, depending on their distance from Hornet:
* <b>Hop:</b> Hops either forwards or backwards, ending their forwards Hop early if it results in contact damage. If they spot Hornet whilst there is distance between them, they always Hop forwards to close the distance.
** They occasionally follow a forwards Hop up with a backwards Hop as a sort of feint.
* <b>Staff Swing:</b> Swings their staff at Hornet at a low angle, then quickly follows it up with a large overhead swing. This move is often followed up with 1–2 backwards Hops, or another Staff Swing if Hornet is still in range.

Dreg Catchers deal {{Damage|1}} with their attack and upon contact.

Due to the rather poor range of Staff Swing, the entire attack can be dodged in one jump, which immediately creates an opening for Hornet to get a hit in, as Dreg Catchers have slight cooldowns between attacks. Dashing can easily close the distance if they attempt to Hop backward, so always try to maintain pressure.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Dreg Catchers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2|
* Spin it, send it...
* Catch it, spool it...
* Why... always this?
* Even these dregs...
* The air... the fields...
* Are we only dregs?
}}

== Location ==
Dreg Catchers can be found in western [[Greymoor]]. Two are encountered as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 5|enemy gauntlet]] in the [[Chapel of the Reaper]], and another two appear during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 1|gauntlet]] inside the tower west of [[Halfway Home]]. In [[Act 3]], three more are fought during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 2|gauntlet]] that takes place in the same tower.

Additionally, two Dreg Catchers in the room west of the [[Bellway]] station disappear under certain conditions: the first stops spawning after a [[Wardenfly]] captures [[Cursed Crest|cursed]] Hornet and is killed by roots, while the second will no longer appear if the platform they occupy is destroyed by [[Moorwing]] during the boss fight.
